material.description: js/client/ui_minimap.js:8 sets SIZE = {hero: 5, creep: 3, building: 7}; paint() draws buildings at SIZE.building (line 111) before units. Own buildings and the own hero both draw OWN_FILL #ffffff (ui_minimap.js:11, fillFor line 78), so the largest white mark on the minimap is a static building rather than the controlled hero (sizeFor line 23 gives the hero SIZE.hero=5). Symptom a maintainer or player sees: own base/tower squares are larger than the own hero dot. Witness: fs_read dispatch 1792858726000-5780-4c7eb85bb546d1d3; codesearch dispatch 1792858893243-5944-1198b819bf3c0cc8.

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: ui_minimap.js:8 SIZE.building 7 vs SIZE.hero 5; paint draws buildings first (:111, :113-116); own buildings and the own hero both use OWN_FILL (:78). Observable: own building squares are the largest white marks, 2 px wider than the own hero dot. The header (:3) says buildings are larger by design, so the fix owner decides whether a hero should outrank them. Read: ui_minimap.js 1-205 dispatch 1792859429070-6387-47df82884af9e433.

material.subject: Minimap: own buildings outrank the own hero dot in size (Visual Hierarchy)
